title: Smoked Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring tender lamb kebabs smothered in a rich, smoky sauce.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the marinade, tossing to coat evenly.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with additional lemon wedges on the side, if desired.
